course.title: C++ Mastery
course.subtitle: Complete C++ Engineering Program
course.tagline: Learn Programming. Build Logic. Master C++.
course.description: C++ from the first program to templates, the STL, memory ownership, DSA and multithreading. Twenty-six modules in six stages, ten learning sections each, and every code sample compiled and run with g++ before it ships, so the output beside a lesson is the compiler's real output.
course.standard: C++17 core · C++20 modern · C++23 where g++ 13 supports it
prerequisites: No prior programming required — Module 00 starts from zero
A computer that can run g++ (or the in-browser lab)
outcomes: Read and write complete C++ programs with confidence
Use variables, operators, conditions, loops and functions correctly
Work with arrays, std::string, pointers and references
Explain stack and heap, and manage memory with RAII and smart pointers
Design classes with constructors, encapsulation and invariants
Apply inheritance, composition and runtime polymorphism
Overload operators with correct value semantics
Write templates and use the STL containers and algorithms
Handle errors with exceptions and files with streams
Use modern C++ features from C++11 through C++23
Solve DSA problems and analyse time and space complexity
Build, test and explain a multi-file C++ project
